name: Graduate Project Seminar I
description: Graduate Project Seminar-II course is a mandatory module for all EPD PhD students. The main objective of this course is to enable graduate students to improve and optimize their research planning, organisation and presentation skills – oral and writing. Besides, it is also meant to encourage graduate students to participate in scientific seminars and to critically evaluate/ assimilate contents. As part of this module, students are required to attend seminars/ invited talks (both internal and external when possible) and also present individual research projects and plans.
